title: Cloudy Code
description: Build your own cloud-based code editor from scratch. Learn how to design real-time collaboration, containerized execution environments, and distributed file systems.
longDescription: Cloudy Code is a comprehensive project-based system where you build a fully functional cloud IDE. From the WebSocket collaboration layer to Docker-based code execution, you'll learn every piece of modern cloud architecture by building it yourself.
author: 100xSystems
